text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — high 5xx rate observed in control-plane dependencies: auth, org-lookup, and config. Pager triggered for #oncall-sre.

alex.kim: seeing spike at 14:02 UTC — auth 502s up ~18% over baseline, org-lookup timeouts increasing. Grafana: https://graf/redwood/controlplane/5xx?from=14:00

maria.s: confirmed. top trace shows timeout to billing-proxy and repeated 502s from config-service on 10.2.3.14.

devlin: digging into k8s: config-service has 5/3/0 restarts on node gpu-wk-7 in last 6m. Logs: `ERROR http: upstream returned 502`.

jamie: running `kubectl get pods -n controlplane -o wide | grep config-service` -> `config-service-6f8d9   1/1 Running   1   3m   10.2.3.14   gpu-wk-7`

oncall-sre: can we triage whether this is resource exhaustion or a regressed release? Any config PRs in last deploy window?

alex.kim: deploys: none to config-service in last 24h. There was a config roll rehydrate at 12:30 but that was a data-only update.

maria.s: stack traces include `orgLookupClient: context deadline exceeded` and `auth-client: handshake failed` — sounds like increased downstream latency leading to circuit breakers tripping.

eng-ops-bot: paging: sent to pd on-call (rotations: @oncall-sre). Alert details: controlplane.deps.5xx.rate > 10% for 3m.

devlin: quick mitigation checklist: 1) enable fallback cache for org-lookup 2) open circuit for billing-proxy 3) scale config-service replicas 4) notify CS for customer impact

jamie: scaling now: `kubectl scale deploy/config-service -n controlplane --replicas=5` — started, pods scheduling.

alex.kim: enabling fallback for org-lookup: flipping feature-flag `org.lookup.strict=false` for 10% rollout. Doing 50% to start. Patch: `curl -XPOST https://config.redwood/api/flags -d '{"org.lookup.strict":false,"percent":50}'`

maria.s: setting circuit for billing-proxy via envoy: `curl -XPOST admin@billing-proxy:9001/commands -d '{"action":"open_circuit"}'` — executed.

support-lead: collecting impact numbers: preliminary: ~7% of API requests to hosted service receiving 5xx. Top affected customers: 3 enterprise tenants with heavy org lookup traffic. Notifying account managers.

oncall-sre: good. runbook says to verify fallback health for 15m then decide rollback or hotfix.

devlin: logs from new config-service pods show fewer 502s, but still some 504s from upstream DB. DB connection pool metrics: exhausted peaks at 95% at 14:05.

jamie: increasing DB pool max connections on config-service to 120 from 80 in-flight via k8s env override, rolling restart. Command snippet:
```
kubectl set env deploy/config-service -n controlplane CONFIG_DB_MAX_CONN=120
kubectl rollout restart deploy/config-service -n controlplane
```

alex.kim: telemetry: 5xx rate dropped to 4.6% at 14:12 after initial mitigations (scaling + flag + circuit). But some customers still reporting errors.

maria.s: tracing shows a pattern: auth-client retries causing request amplification to org-lookup. We should throttle retries client-side temporarily.

oncall-sre: adding retry-budget: set auth-client max_retries=1 via config push. Patch applied to canary.

eng-ops-bot: NOTE: temporary mitigations in place: scaled config-service -> 5 replicas, org-lookup fallback enabled at 50%, billing-proxy circuit open, auth-client retries limited. Monitoring 15m.

support-lead: Customer comms draft: "We are experiencing elevated 5xx rates caused by increased dependency latency in control plane services (auth, org lookup, config). Engineers have applied mitigations; we are monitoring and will provide updates every 30 minutes." Sending to AMs now.

devlin: observed error breakdown (14:00-14:14): auth 502s 52%, org-lookup timeouts 28%, config 504 20%.

jamie: rolling back a recent non-critical config rehydrate isn't necessary yet — mitigations seem effective. But we should keep rollback as option.

oncall-sre: handing off to next on-call in 30m. If 5xx stays <5% and no customer escalations, we'll de-escalate.

maria.s: propose postmortem checklist items: - root cause hypothesis: transient DB connection storm + retry amplification - fix: client retry backoff + connection pool tuning - follow-ups: add per-tenant org-lookup rate-limiting and better telemetry on retry storms

alex.kim: agreed. Adding a quick alarm tweak: alert threshold to 8% for 5xx with expanded runbook link.

support-lead: update: two affected enterprise customers acknowledged; CS created SEVs with their teams (refs: #AM-124, #AM-125).

eng-ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE at 14:25 UTC: 5xx rate steady at 3.9%. No new sign of config restart loops. Continue monitoring.

jamie: leaving a note in deploy log and will capture pod diffs: `kubectl describe pod config-service-6f8d9` -> attached to ticket.

devlin: if we see recurrence, next step: isolate auth traffic to alternate cluster/region, enable degraded auth path, and throttle non-essential telemetry.

oncall-sre: handing off to @alex.kim for next shift. Handoff summary: mitigations applied, 5xx reduced to ~4%, ongoing monitor for 30m, CS notified.

alex.kim: acked. I'll monitor dashboards and coordinate any customer escalations. If 5xx creeps back >8%, I'll re-page infra-sre and eng-runtime.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MARKED: mitigations applied; status -> monitoring. Updates: https://graf/redwood/incidents/3400012345

support-lead: post-incident immediate actions: notify affected customers with timeline, schedule postmortem in 48h, assign owners for follow-ups.

maria.s: adding postmortem owners: devlin (root cause remediation), jamie (config-service stability), alex.kim (alert tuning), support-lead (customer comms).

eng-ops-bot: final note: created ticket CP-3400012345 for tracking follow-ups and RCA.
